source: Historical structural (FWD) deflection survey — road-network structural assessment dataset
method: Falling Weight Deflectometer deflection-bowl readings (D1-D7, standard load plate) per chainage point, aggregated per road link. SNC = modified structural number computed per reading from the deflection bowl.
note: A separate, denser structural dataset from the Measured FWD Deflection Surveys above — different survey batch, different road set. Road name/region/class/surface joined from the national network register by road number where matched.
